digest.component_or_area: completion verifier and plan-review close gate
propositions: Completion verifier blocks close when acceptance criteria no longer match reality, forcing operators toward illegitimate workarounds (--force-close or --ref to old commits) that leave inaccurate state in the ticket system.

The correct remediation path when ACs are invalidated by the fix or are auto-generated/unverifiable is to edit the ticket, re-pass plan review, and close against corrected criteria, but this path is not documented.
The --ref <landing-commit> flag provides a legitimate close path for ACs invalidated by subsequent work (not by the fix itself), but this sanctioned use is undocumented in the close workflow.

Plan-review close gate's stale-regver check blocks closure of completed and merged work when the criteria registry changes since the original plan review, forcing costly re-review of already-executed plans.
